checkpoint_saving: Immutable periodic epochs1/5/10/20/30 plus best snapshot serialized in RAM and written once at completion; last=30; all epoch curves retained; no overwrite

evaluation.K20: independent ADE and FDE minima per target; first sample is candidate0
evaluation.every_epoch: full validation all metrics plus original supervised posterior objective; same per-target noise across epochs
evaluation.method: external evaluation-only Gaussian standard-noise provider through temporary distribution hooks; original loc/scale, forward, parameters and loss unchanged; remove hooks before training
evaluation.prior: original deterministic latent-prior-mean trajectory, not expectation over predicted trajectories

failure_policy: First nonfinite stops affected run, save failure model/optimizer/RNG/batch and traceback; no retry. Other preregistered runs may complete.
initialization: seed_all(17), same frozen constructor; random weights, no old checkpoint initialization; exact state/RNG audit
loss: unchanged official mean reconstruction + Monte Carlo latent KL mean; not exact marginal NLL
model_selection: minimum validation target-window-weighted K1 latent-prior ADE; exact tie earlier epoch; FDE from same checkpoint

scheduling.rule: exactly four independent processes, shared GPU; wall time includes contention, no settings depend on results

smoke: Epochs1..5 within same run; if all diagnostics/strict restore finite, continue unchanged to30; never restart from smoke

stopping.failure: Stop current hypothesis on any failed gate; no ratio/threshold/model/seed/budget search
stopping.speed_gate: HOTEL speed_normal window-weighted abs(mean signed bias), also report mean(abs(per-target bias)) and ID weights

training_order.changes: Same N visits/ceil(N/128) updates per epoch; repeated target windows and unique coverage differ; no target-future input
training_order.probability: P(i)=0.5/N+0.5/(G*N_g); G counts only nonempty history-speed classes
training_order.speed: mean norm of seven consecutive raw historical displacements / 0.4 seconds; float64
